g.text: Fleet & Incident - Class Design (Mai Hoang Phuong Dong, 2452265)
+recordArrival(ctx: Context, orderId: String, vehicleIds: Set<String>): RedistributionOrder
+updateOrder(ctx: Context, orderId: String, action: OrderAction): RedistributionOrder
+updateIncident(ctx: Context, ticketId: String, update: IncidentUpdate): IncidentTicket
IncidentTicket targets SharedVehicle XOR ChargingPoint; equivalent open faults share one ticket.
arrivedVehicleIds is a subset of assignedVehicleIds; only recordArrival confirms physical movement.
One active transfer per vehicle. A new fault before closure invalidates recovery and reopens investigation.
External state is accessed through owner contracts, not direct repository writes.
DTOs, enums, transaction rules and errors: method-design/04-fleet-incident.md.
Entity methods enforce local transitions; application services enforce cross-resource safety.
